en: R-Right. I'm sorry for worrying you.
Huh? Is that you, Kiryu-san!?
Long time no see, Mama.

You shouldn't surprise me like this!
I might have had a heart attack!
Heh, sorry about that.

This means you're a free man, right?
I know, we should get everyone together!

That won't be necessary, Mama.
I just dropped in to say hello.
Oh, is that all?

Anyway, I ran into Date-san.
Sounds like the city's getting dangerous.

It's true. Can't seem to go a day without
hearing about another murder.

It feels like things are changing,
and not for the better.
You should be careful, Kiryu-san.

By the way, Mama, there are
some things I wanted to ask you.
Do you know where Akiyama is?

Oh, Akiyama-san?
Sorry, I have no idea.

He closed shop a little while back.
I haven't seen him since he left.

I just hope he hasn't gotten himself
wrapped up in anything dubious.
Have you seen Haruka around at all?

Huh? Haruka-chan?
Why do you ask?

Not long after I went to jail,
she left Okinawa all by herself.

There's more to the story than that,
but I'm only back here to look for her.

Wow, that must be tough on you.
I thought she was still in Okinawa.

To be honest, it's been years
since I saw her last.
But I'll call you if I hear anything.

Oh, and feel free to drop in here
whenever you want. Don't be shy.
I appreciate it, Mama.
Sorry, we're still closed for today.
Wait, is that you, Kiryu-san!?
It's been a while, old friend.

You're darn right it has.
Let me pour you a drink, Kiryu-san.

I appreciate the offer, but I'm actually
just here to ask a few questions.
That so? How can I help?

You know Akiyama from
over at Sky Finance?

Oh, Akiyama-san.
Of course I know him.

He's been impossible to reach lately.
You haven't seen him around, have you?

To tell the truth, I haven't. He stopped
taking his strolls by here a while back.

Rumor has it, he got caught in a feud
with those folks over in Little Asia.
I haven't seen or heard from him since.

Hm, I'll keep that in mind.
Thanks.
Has Haruka been by here at all?

Wait, Haruka-chan? I would have
thought she'd be with you.

She's not. Long story short,
I need to figure out where she is.

Oh, sorry to hear that.
Wish I could do more for you.

If I hear anything,
you'll be the first to know.

(Looks like Little Asia is the only option
I've got left. Let's just hope for the best.)

(Hold on, didn't Little Asia burn down?
They built all this back up in a year...?)

(If they're really this capable, no wonder
the Tojo Clan is struggling with them.)

Goddamn Chinese!
They took out two more!
They'll pay for this!
These guys must be the triads.
Hey. You got problem?
No, not really.
I don't like look of you.

That's a strange way to say hello.
What did I do to you?
Let go!

Wh-Who are you?
What you want?

Funny you ask.
I have a question for you.

Do you know a man named Akiyama?
He used
 to run a company called Sky Finance.
I was told you guys were looking for him.
I not know this Akiyama man.
[Hey, we're done here. Come on.]

Th-There's no mistaking him.
That guy is the fourth chairman.
The Dragon of Dojima is back?
Let's go. HQ needs to hear this.
(Looks like I've hit a dead end here.)

(I guess I'll head back to Sky Finance
to see what I can learn.)

What you want? This area off-limits.
Go away.
(More Chinese? They seem to be triads too.)

Why you just stand there?
Hurry up and go!

No need to take that tone.
Are you hiding something back there?

Absolutely not!
Just get out of here like I say!

What you think you doing?
Why you so quiet?

Fine, you got it. You wanna know what we
got back here so bad, I let you see. Come.

[Stay here.
Make sure nobody else gets in.]

[Hey, who the hell is that guy? I thought
I told you not to let anyone back here!]

[Some shady bastard. He insisted, so I
thought we'd have him join the party.]

[What should we do with him then?
You want to kill him too?]

[Fine by me. Killing one more of
these fools won't make a difference.]

Kinda weird. I don't speak a word of
Chinese, but I got the gist of that.
Wait, you're Japanese, aren't you!?

Help! They're gonna slice me to bits!
Please, you gotta help me!

I'm not sure what's going on here,
but I can't just leave this guy to die.

Hm? You really want to take all of
us at once? This going to be fun.

[Don't hold anything back.
Let's kill this bastard!]

Ah, I'm saved!
Hey, come untie me. Hurry!

I can't believe I'm still alive.
Guess I should be thanking you.

I gotta say, old man, you're a crazy
good fighter. That was incredible!

That's enough about me.
Why were these guys trying to kill you?
Well... Because I'm in the Tojo Clan.

The triads will go after any yakuza
they spot, even green ones like me.

Traveling in groups seems to be the
only way to make them back down.

I was just unlucky enough to get
caught
 while I was out by myself.

So that attack was totally unprovoked?
They must really be out for blood.

It's not just Tojo guys either. They're
even
 going after gray-area civilians.

Anyone with half a brain has gone
into hiding to avoid getting targeted.

I get it now. That must be why they're
hunting down Akiyama, too.
Did you just say Akiyama?

The guy from Sky Finance?
Shun Akiyama?
You know him?

Hell yeah I do. Sky Finance used to
be right here in this building.
It shut down a few months ago, though.

I heard Akiyama's been avoiding the
Chinese ever since.

He's got connections to the Tojo Clan's
sixth chairman, so they want him bad.

Do you know where
 Akiyama is now?

Not exactly. I saw him around
pretty recently, though.

He was looking pretty rough, chilling with
 a
bunch of hobos over at the Children's Park.
You looking for Akiyama too, old man?
I am. Thanks for the info.

It's the least I can do!
You totally saved my life!

Hey, I'm Murota from the Jinsei Family.
I'm a recent recruit, but I know I can help.
What's your name, tough guy?

Kiryu-san, huh...
Well, I'll see you around!

Kiryu... Kiryu...?
Kazuma Kiryu...!?
Nahhh, no way.
Th-That couldn't have been him... Right?
Hey, man. You know a guy named Akiyama?

He used to run a loan company
 called Sky Finance.
I heard he was seen here recently.
What've you got to do with him?

He's an old friend of mine. Now what do
you know about Akiyama? Where is he?

Tell me what you know. Kiryu's the one
asking, if that counts for anything.

Wait, Kiryu?
As in, Kazuma Kiryu?
S-Seriously?

Man, I knew I recognized you somehow.
I think I saw you on TV a ways back!

Weren't you on the news or something?
Maybe three or four years ago?

Akiyama-san's mentioned you before.
Hm, he'd probably wanna see you.

So you know where he is after all.
Where can I find him?
He's close. I could show you...

...But there's something I need before
I can do that. Got time to hear me out?

Could you maybe grab me one of
them convenience store bentos?
Hm? That's all?

That's all. Happiness is a warm meal,
you know?

After ya've been on the streets this long,
that's all that really matters.
All right. I'll be back soon.

Here you go.
I brought you a bento.

Thanks, friend.
Man, I'm starving.

Mmm, so freaking good. It's been
ages since I've felt this full.

Guess I should keep my promise.
I'll tell you where Akiyama is.
You said he's close by, right?
Yup, closer than you'd think.
Just down here.

I see what you meant by "close."
Akiyama's inside, then?
You'll find out soon enough.

Then... You don't know
where Haruka is either.

I'm sorry, Kiryu-san. I know you came
all the way from Okinawa for this.

It's okay. I didn't even stop to consider
your situation before barging in here.
So what's the plan now?

I'll keep asking around Kamurocho
about
 Haruka. Not much choice.
You know I'd help if I could.
Just keep yourself safe.
Oh crap...
Who's he?

The big guy in the back? That's Ed.
He's the Saio Triad's welcoming committee.
Ed?

Not to pin this all on you, but...
Kiryu-san, were you followed?
Hey, that look...

I heard a very interesting man
showed up in Kamurocho today.

Quite convenient that he
led me right to Akiyama here.

So, this guy is actually strong enough
to force you into hiding?

Well, he did make me abandon my
company
 and move to the sewers.

I almost didn't recognize you,
Akiyama-san.

You used to have such style, but now
your
 stench makes the bigger impact.
He's really good at pissing me off, too.

And Akiyama-san has a guest. I see now.
Our grunts were never a match for you.
You're... Kazuma Kiryu, aren't you?

Former Tojo Clan Fourth Chairman,
the Dragon
 of Dojima. A legend among yakuza.
Your name made the list as well.

Kiryu-san. You as rusty as the bars
you were locked behind?

Not sure. I never skipped
my morning exercises, though.
What a healthy guy.

Unfortunately for you, yakuza
 cannot
choose where they meet their end.
The two of you will die where you stand!

You cowards! How dare you
team up against a single opponent!

You're one to talk. By my count,
you had four dudes backing you up.

Consider this fight a mere greeting.
I will see the two of you again.

You know, there's no way I could've
handled that guy without you.
Glad you're on my side, Kiryu-san.

Likewise. Even so, he got
away fairly unscathed.
There a lot of guys in the triad like him?
I prefer to think of him as an exception.

Either way, my palace here isn't much of
a hideout anymore. Let's head up.

(How did Haruka end up in an accident?
Damn it, what's going on here!?)

And what about the father?
Who's the father of this child!?
We don't know.
You don't <font_kind=yakuza_italic>know</font_kind>?

There was nothing on her person that
would have helped us identify him.

Her phone was broken in the accident,
but we're trying to extract its data.

Beyond that, we aren't even sure
when Haruka arrived in Kamurocho.
We'll have to ask her once she wakes up.
And she's definitely going to wake up?
We can't promise that.

My apologies, but I don't want to give
you any false hope here.

The doctors are doing everything in
their power. All we can do is pray.

Senpai, I should get going. There's still
work to be done at the crime scene.

Hold on a minute.
Honjo-san, wasn't it?
Where did her accident happen?

Why does it matter? Going there
yourself won't change the situation.

We're already pursuing the culprit.
A washed-up yakuza should stay out of it.

Hey, Honjo.
Watch your mouth.

He can say whatever he wants.
I'm not going to just stand here and wait.

Haruka should have been in Okinawa,
but she ended up in an accident here instead.

I don't understand.
Who was the bastard driving that car?

And more importantly, was this
really just a simple accident?
But Haruka...

Do you mean someone may have tried to
kill her? Maybe to get revenge on you?

It's possible.
And there would be no forgiveness.
Wait. All right.

The accident took place near Senryo Avenue.
I can take you there if you'd like.
That okay by you, Date-san?
Yeah, if you don't mind. Thanks.

We're here. Haruka Sawamura was here
with her child just a few hours ago.

At that point, she was struck
from behind by a black sedan.

The car flew out of that parking garage,
taking out the gate in the process.
In the car was a lone man.

Some gangbanger in his twenties.
He fled immediately after hitting them.
A gang...

Remember, the Tojo Clan and the
triads are in an all-out war.

It's possible our culprit was trying to
escape from a related incident.

Which would be why he lost
control of the car...

If you're right, which side was he on?
Tojo Clan or the triads?
Not necessarily either.

It's not like those are the only
active syndicates in Kamurocho.
Let me back up a bit.

Three months ago, a Chinese immigrant
was murdered. He was Saio Triad.

And not only was he a ranking officer,
but he was the boss's only son, too.

In other words, he stood to inherit
the entire triad. His name was Jimmy Lo.
Tensions really escalated after his death.

The Tojo's sixth chairman was arrested,
and the conflict sparked up all over again.

And the Tojo Clan?
Did they kill Jimmy Lo?

We're still not sure ourselves.
The Saio seem to believe so, though.

They've started scouring the city for any
Tojo yakuza they can get their hands on.

To retaliate, the Tojo Clan has been driving
the Chinese out, even civilians. It's a mess.

To top it off, other groups are moving into
Kamurocho to take advantage of the chaos.

There's no way that the Tojo and the Saio
are the only ones involved in this by now.

It wouldn't surprise me if the guy who
hit Haruka was from a third party.
